article.story: AUBURN HILLS, Mich. -- — Orlando Lovejoy had 29 points in Detroit Mercy's 95-89 win over Oakland on Saturday. Lovejoy shot 13 of 16 from the field and 3 for 4 from the line for the Titans (15-14, 12-8 Horizon League). TJ Nadeau scored 28 points while going 7 of 11 from the floor, including 5 for 7 from 3-point range, and 9 for 10 from the line, and added five assists. Tyler Spratt had 15 points. Tuburu Niavalurua led the Golden Grizzlies (16-15, 12-8) in scoring, finishing with 24 points. Brody Robinson added 19 points and nine assists for Oakland. Brett White II also had 17 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
